name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: Along Westfall's shore, Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure sends you inland. You leave the coast and follow the next mark in his scattered trail.

sections.title: A Trail of Inland Riddles
sections.body: Captain Sanders left riddles across the countryside instead of marking one cache by the beach. The solved cipher points beyond rocky bluffs toward Westfall's main roads.

sections.title: Ruins Along the Road
sections.body: Among the roadside ruins, an old chimney marks the next stop. A discarded, weathered barrel nearby holds another message, and the ruined farmstead gives Sanders a landmark for his trail.

faq.answer: Captain Sanders was a pirate captain who sailed along Westfall's coasts. He scattered clues and riddles across the region for anyone seeking his hidden wealth.

faq.q: Where does this clue send you?
faq.answer: The clue sends you east from the western sea, up the bluffs and toward the road. Beside an old stone chimney in the ruins, a broken barrel holds the next piece of the puzzle.

faq.q: Why did Sanders hide his treasure in pieces?
faq.answer: Sanders divided the directions among several riddles to keep rivals and the authorities from finding his hidden wealth. Only a persistent, resourceful seeker can follow the trail to its final cache.

faq.q: Is the treasure hunt dangerous to follow?
faq.answer: The clues are parchment and old containers, but Westfall's roads and fields bring danger. Wandering beasts, prowling gnolls, and hostile members of the Defias Brotherhood threaten travelers near abandoned homesteads.

faq.q: What kind of ruins is the barrel hidden near?
faq.answer: The barrel lies beside the crumbling stone chimney of a ruined building near the road. Many Westfall homesteads have been abandoned or demolished during recent years of turmoil.

faq.q: Does this quest reveal the treasure itself?
faq.answer: No. This step reveals another clue. Sanders laid out several stages across the region before anyone can find the actual prize.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can use stealth and cunning to decipher pirate ciphers and search abandoned ruins for forgotten spoils.
As an Alliance traveler, you can follow Sanders' trail along Westfall's lawless coast and untended inland roads. The local militia struggles against organized outlaws.
